scope: Only acute-ischemic-stroke and ct-mri-screenshot exact canonical source sections; not a repository-wide583-file rerun.

rules.observed_rule: Activate the stroke pathway immediately; obtain noncontrast brain imaging and vascular imaging according to local capability without avoidable delay.
rules.comparison_scope: Candidate literal mapped to prior AHA/ASA2026 review; no new complete guideline read or claim of final supplement verification.

rules.observed_rule: Evaluate disabling deficit, hemorrhage, large-vessel occlusion and mimics. Do not use a low NIHSS alone to dismiss a disabling presentation.
rules.comparison_scope: Candidate literal mapped to prior AHA/ASA2026 review; no new complete guideline read or claim of final supplement verification.

rules.observed_rule: Verify the current thrombolytic agent, weight-based dose, time/imaging window, blood-pressure requirement and contraindications. Pursue thrombectomy assessment independently of thrombolysis eligibility.
rules.comparison_scope: Candidate literal mapped to prior AHA/ASA2026 review; no new complete guideline read or claim of final supplement verification.

rules.observed_rule: Monitor airway, glucose, temperature, BP and neurologic change; admit/transfer to a stroke-capable unit.
rules.comparison_scope: Candidate literal mapped to prior AHA/ASA2026 review; no new complete guideline read or claim of final supplement verification.

rules.observed_rule: Complete volumetric DICOM and specialist reading required by project safeguard; incomplete screenshots cannot exclude critical pathology.
rules.scope_limit: This is a project input-quality/abstention policy, not a newly verified literal universal DICOM-file mandate attributed to AHA/ASA.

rules.observed_rule: No unsupported universal hemorrhage-volume threshold; traumatic hemorrhage/mass effect is routed to traumatic-intracranial-mass-effect.
rules.scope_limit: Do not conflate AIS eligibility with BTF traumatic EDH/SDH surgical thresholds or spontaneous ICH recommendations.
